metadata.name: amphetamin-group-staging
metadata.naming_note: Proposed logical names only. Confirm account-wide uniqueness before provisioning.
metadata.secret_inventory_note: No secret bindings are declared in the inspected AMPHETAMIN entrypoint or GROUP Worker entrypoint; audit the complete runtime dependency graph before provisioning. Never store secret values here.

requirements: Attach an Access application to the exact staging AMPHETAMIN hostname.
Default deny; allow only explicitly approved subject identities.
Do not use a broad email-domain rule as the sole authorization condition.
Verify application and policy attachment to the exact hostname before edge tests.
Record policy ID, application ID, hostname, and read-back timestamp as approval evidence.

identity.note: Confirm single-tenant versus multi-tenant staging. Do not infer shared tenant/project mapping from current code.

provisioning_sequence: Approve staging identity model and exact allowed Access subjects.
Read back production Worker names, Service Binding target, D1 ID, and Access policy as comparison evidence.
Confirm proposed staging names are unused across the Cloudflare account.
Provision one dedicated staging D1 database and record its returned ID.
Provision staging GROUP with workers.dev, Preview URLs, routes, and custom domains disabled.
Provision staging AMPHETAMIN with workers.dev and Preview URLs disabled; bind GROUP only to staging GROUP.
Bind AMPHETAMIN.RUNTIME_DB and GROUP.DB to the same staging D1.
Attach a default-deny Access application and explicit allow policy to the staging AMPHETAMIN hostname.
Populate non-secret tenant/project identifiers and secret references through approved secure interfaces.
Run paired repository preflight, verify migration hashes, and obtain separate migration and edge-test approvals.
Only after every gate passes, perform separately approved staging deployment and authenticated edge smoke tests.
hard_stops: Never reuse production Worker, Service Binding, D1 database, tenant ID, or project ID.
GROUP must have no public ingress; it is Service-Binding-only.
No staging deployment while Access policy verification is false.
No migrations without separate explicit approval.
Never store secret or credential values in this manifest.
No provisioning or deployment while authorization flags are false.
